title: From ideas to a clear presentation

fields.Presentation title:
From ideas to a
clear presentation
fields.Subtitle: Agree the story before building the slides

slides.notes: This manifest demonstrates the content format. Replace it with the presenter's approved wording.

fields.Slide title: A clear brief gives the talk direction
fields.Lead statement: Decide what the audience should understand or do differently after the session.
fields.Main points:
Identify the audience and their starting point.
Choose one central message.
Agree the time available and the intended outcome.

slides.notes: Ask the presenter which outcome matters most. Keep the discussion focused on the audience, not on slide count.

fields.Slide title: Turn the accepted story into an editable deck
fields.Main points:
Organise a sequence with a clear beginning and ending.
Refine the wording and speaker notes together.
Approve the content, then build and visually check the slides.
fields.Takeaway: The template supports the message; it does not decide the message.

slides.notes: Close with the next decision or action. Allow time for the audience's questions.
